_note: Jargon popups (owner, 28 Oct 2026): each word's meaning in IMOBX's world, not a dictionary. Forms are matched as whole words, longest first. Status 'draft' = for the owner to read before it counts as final.

pt.meaning: Um ativo digital registrado numa blockchain, como o bitcoin ou um token.

en.meaning: A digital asset recorded on a blockchain, such as bitcoin or a token.

nl.meaning: Een digitaal bezit dat op een blockchain is vastgelegd, zoals bitcoin of een token.

pt.meaning: Uma lista digital e pública, copiada em muitos computadores, onde dá para acrescentar anotações e todas ficam. A IMOBX quer usar uma para a sua prestação de contas, para que qualquer pessoa confira para onde foi o recurso.

en.meaning: A public digital list copied on many computers, where entries can be added and all of them stay. IMOBX wants to use one for its accounting, so anyone can check where the funding went.

nl.meaning: Een openbare digitale lijst, gekopieerd op veel computers, waar regels bij kunnen en alles blijft staan. IMOBX wil er een gebruiken voor haar boekhouding, zodat iedereen kan nagaan waar de financiering heen ging.

pt.meaning: A blockchain que a IMOBX pretende usar. Foi criada pela Circle, a empresa do USDC, e funciona desde setembro de 2026. As taxas são pagas em USDC.

en.meaning: The blockchain IMOBX plans to use. Circle, the company behind USDC, built it; it has run since September 2026. Its fees are paid in USDC.

nl.meaning: De blockchain die IMOBX wil gebruiken. Circle, het bedrijf achter USDC, bouwde hem; hij draait sinds september 2026. De kosten worden in USDC betaald.

pt.meaning: Um dólar digital emitido pela empresa Circle. As taxas na blockchain Arc são pagas com ele. As famílias pagam em reais.

en.meaning: A digital dollar issued by the company Circle. Fees on the Arc blockchain are paid in it. Families pay in reais.

nl.meaning: Een digitale dollar, uitgegeven door het bedrijf Circle. De kosten op de Arc-blockchain worden ermee betaald. Gezinnen betalen in reais.

pt.meaning: Um aplicativo para guardar tokens. O aluguel é pago em reais.

en.meaning: An app for holding tokens. Rent is paid in reais.

nl.meaning: Een app om tokens te bewaren. Huur betaal je in reais.

pt.meaning: Uma unidade digital registrada numa blockchain. O token da IMOBX é um token self-compounding de financiamento da comunidade: suas taxas de negociação financiam a comunidade em torno das casas.

en.meaning: A digital unit recorded on a blockchain. The IMOBX token is a self-compounding community-funding token: its trading fees fund the community around the houses.

nl.meaning: Een digitale eenheid die op een blockchain is vastgelegd. Het IMOBX-token is een self-compounding token dat de gemeenschap financiert: de handelsvergoedingen financieren de gemeenschap rond de huizen.

pt.meaning: Uma pequena cobrança feita a cada vez que alguém compra ou vende um token.

en.meaning: A small charge made each time someone buys or sells a token.

nl.meaning: Een kleine heffing, elke keer dat iemand een token koopt of verkoopt.

pt.meaning: O recurso só sai quando mais de uma pessoa, com nome conhecido, aprova o pagamento.

en.meaning: Funding moves only when more than one named person approves the payment.

nl.meaning: Financiering gaat pas weg als meer dan één persoon met naam de betaling goedkeurt.

pt.meaning: Cada pagamento que a IMOBX faz: para quê, quanto, quem aprovou e quando. Qualquer pessoa pode conferir. Seus dados pessoais e seus pagamentos continuam privados.

en.meaning: Every payment IMOBX makes: what it was for, how much, who approved it and when. Anyone can check it. Your personal data and your own payments stay private.

nl.meaning: Elke betaling die IMOBX doet: waarvoor, hoeveel, wie het goedkeurde en wanneer. Iedereen kan het nagaan. Jouw persoonsgegevens en jouw eigen betalingen blijven privé.

pt.meaning: A Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados. Ela dá a você o direito de ver, corrigir e pedir que apaguem os seus dados pessoais.

en.meaning: Brazil's personal data law (Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados). It gives you the right to see, correct and have your personal data deleted.

nl.meaning: De Braziliaanse privacywet (Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados). Die geeft je het recht je persoonsgegevens in te zien, te verbeteren en te laten wissen.

pt.meaning: A Comissão de Valores Mobiliários, que fiscaliza investimentos no Brasil. Ela decide quando um token conta como investimento e precisa seguir as suas regras.

en.meaning: Brazil's securities regulator (Comissão de Valores Mobiliários). It decides when a token counts as an investment that must follow its rules.

nl.meaning: De Braziliaanse toezichthouder op beleggingen (Comissão de Valores Mobiliários). Die bepaalt wanneer een token als belegging telt en aan zijn regels moet voldoen.

pt.meaning: Um órgão público que faz e fiscaliza as regras de um mercado. Para investimentos no Brasil, é a CVM.

en.meaning: A public body that sets and enforces the rules of a market. For investments in Brazil, that is the CVM.

nl.meaning: Een overheidsinstantie die de regels van een markt maakt en handhaaft. Voor beleggingen in Brazilië is dat de CVM.

pt.meaning: Uma organização que pertence aos seus membros e é dirigida por eles. Numa cooperativa de crédito, os membros poupam e pegam empréstimos juntos.

en.meaning: An organisation owned and run by its members. In a credit cooperative, members save and borrow together.

nl.meaning: Een organisatie die van haar leden is en door hen wordt bestuurd. In een kredietcoöperatie sparen en lenen leden samen.

pt.meaning: Quem dá ou empresta recursos ao projeto: doadores, quem concede subsídios e investidores.

en.meaning: Anyone who gives or lends funding to the project: donors, grant-makers and investors.

nl.meaning: Iedereen die het project financiering geeft of leent: donateurs, subsidiegevers en investeerders.

pt.meaning: Deixar seus tokens travados por um tempo para apoiar o projeto. Para tirá-los, há um prazo de espera definido no contrato.

en.meaning: Locking your tokens for a while to support the project. Taking them out again has a waiting period set in the contract.

nl.meaning: Je tokens een tijd vastzetten om het project te steunen. Ze weer vrijmaken kent een wachttijd die in het contract staat.

pt.meaning: A lista de quem pode usar os serviços e benefícios da comunidade. O token é a sua chave para entrar nela.

en.meaning: Puts you on the list of people who can use the community’s services and benefits. The token is your key to that list.

nl.meaning: De lijst van mensen die de diensten en voordelen van de gemeenschap kunnen gebruiken. De token is je sleutel tot die lijst.

pt.meaning: O registro de ajuda real na IMOBX: pontos que você ganha quando outras pessoas confirmam a ajuda que você deu. O Zeal é conquistado, continua seu e cresce com o que você faz.

en.meaning: IMOBX’s record of real help: points you earn when others confirm the help you gave. Zeal is earned, stays yours and grows with what you do.

nl.meaning: Het overzicht van echte hulp bij IMOBX: punten die je verdient als anderen bevestigen dat je hebt geholpen. Zeal verdien je, het blijft van jou en groeit met wat je doet.
